sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I'm back at my hotel, but my door won't open.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I take my key card down to reception.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Hi, my key card doesn't work on my room door.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sorry about that, what happens when you try it?

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: There's a beep, and the light flashes red.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Okay, let's check your card and get you in.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Do I tap it or put it in?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Just tap it against the reader above the handle.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Right, I did that, but I still couldn't get in.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Let me check the exact room number first.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I show my ID and point to my room number.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: It's room twelve, and I'm staying two more nights.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Thanks, I'll reset this card for your stay.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Is there an extra charge to reset it?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: No, there's no extra charge for resetting this card.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Great, can I have a spare key card as well?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, I'll make you a spare while you're here.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Will my first card still work after you do that?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, both cards will work for your room.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: How long should I hold it against the reader?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Hold it there till the green light comes on, then push the handle down.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Sorry, what do I do when the light turns green?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Push the handle down when it's green.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Before heading upstairs, I check the next step.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Okay, I'll try again with this card.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Good, keep your spare somewhere safe.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: What if I hear a beep but it flashes red again?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Call reception from the phone next to the lift.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can someone come up and help me at the door?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Of course, we'll send someone up to help you.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, I've got both cards and know what to try.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I've checked the steps and know how to get help.
